style: Hand-drawn 2D cartoon illustration for a YouTube history explainer. Simple stick-figure people with large round plain white heads, black dot eyes, expressive eyebrows, small simple mouths, messy dark hair, thin black stick arms and legs, teal striped hide tunics with a tooth necklace; thick clean black ink outlines, flat bright colors with soft painterly shading, richly detailed painted cartoon backgrounds (caves, savanna, firelight, starry skies). Funny, gentle, not gory. 16:9 widescreen. Absolutely no text, letters, captions or watermark in the image. Compose for a vertical crop: keep the subject and action in the CENTRAL 4:3 area of the 16:9 frame.

shots.p: A small sleepy grey-brown puppy wrapped in a soft fur blanket by a glowing campfire, two pairs of gentle stick-figure hands offering it a bowl of water, cosy firelit rock shelter at night.
shots.line: Fourteen thousand years ago, people nursed a very sick puppy for weeks.

shots.p: Close-up of a puppy's jaw with small teeth showing faint bands and pits on the enamel, lit by a museum magnifying glass held by a friendly stick-figure scientist in a lab coat.
shots.line: Its teeth tell the story.

shots.p: Hero shot: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) standing at a cave entrance with arms spread in a big curious shrug, a wolf-like dog silhouette and a fox peeking from bushes either side, sunset mountains behind.
shots.line: So, did cavemen have pets?

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) kneeling with hands clasped, eyes huge and pleading, gazing at a fluffy puppy sitting on a rock just out of reach, wildflowers around, funny and sweet.
shots.line: Meet Moss. He wants a puppy.

shots.p: Painted cutaway of a quiet earth grave near a wooded hillside by a wide river (the Rhine), showing a stick-figure man and woman lying peacefully with a small dog curled beside them, soft red ochre dust, calm and respectful, not gory.
shots.line: Surprise one: in Germany, it was buried with a man and a woman.

shots.p: The thin, droopy puppy lying on a fur bed with half-closed eyes and a little fever glow around its head, a worried stick-figure woman stroking it in a dim hide tent.
shots.line: It had a nasty illness called distemper.

shots.p: A giant painted stone calendar of three moon phases with a small droopy puppy at its foot, the last moon fading, dark cave background, gentle and serious.
shots.line: Without care, it would die within three weeks.

shots.p: A cheerful painted stone calendar with eight moon phases glowing in a row above the puppy, now sitting up and wagging its tail, firelight warming the scene.
shots.line: But it lived about eight more weeks.

shots.p: Three-panel comic: left, a stick-figure woman wrapping the puppy in furs by the fire; middle, a man offering it soft meat and water; right, someone gently wiping its fur clean with moss.
shots.line: Experts think someone kept it warm, fed and clean.

shots.p: A sad little puppy sitting beside a pile of untouched hunting gear and a sled, too weak to pull, a stick-figure hunter shrugging kindly.
shots.line: A sick puppy can't work.

shots.p: A stick-figure man and woman cuddling the puppy between them by the campfire, a small glowing heart floating above, starry sky, warm and tender.
shots.line: So it was probably loved.

shots.p: A long friendly line of stick-figure cavepeople walking across a grassy Ice Age plain, each with a dog trotting beside them, mammoths far in the distance, golden light.
shots.line: Surprise two: dogs are our oldest animal friends.

shots.p: A huge round stone 'age' tablet with many tally-mark notches round its rim, a stick-figure caveperson and a wolf-like dog sitting side by side in front of it, looking up together.
shots.line: They've lived with us at least fifteen thousand years.

shots.p: A bright-eyed red fox popping its head out of a cave doorway with a surprised expression, autumn leaves swirling, warm daylight.
shots.line: Surprise three: a fox!

shots.p: Painted cutaway of a stone-lined grave in dry rocky Jordanian hills, a stick-figure person resting peacefully with a red fox curled nearby, calm and respectful, not gory.
shots.line: In Jordan, about sixteen thousand years ago, a fox was buried with a person.

shots.p: A friendly stick-figure scientist in a sun hat scratching their head beside the fox, a big painted question mark shape made of pebbles on the ground (no letters), funny.
shots.line: A pet? Maybe. Scientists aren't sure.

shots.p: Painted cutaway of a round stone house floor in green Galilee hills, a stick-figure woman lying peacefully on her side with one hand resting gently on a small puppy, soft dawn light, tender and respectful.
shots.line: Surprise four: in Israel, about twelve thousand years ago, a woman was buried with her hand on a puppy.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) sitting by a campfire surrounded by a happy stick-figure family, two dogs dozing in the warmth and a fox peeking in from the dark, sparks rising.
shots.line: So yes, cavemen had furry friends.

shots.p: A stick-figure Stone Age family huddled under one big fur blanket with their dog snuggled in the middle, everyone smiling, a gentle snowfall outside the cave mouth.
shots.line: Some were cared for like family.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) holding an empty bone plate with his mouth wide open in shock while a fluffy puppy runs off with a big roasted drumstick, tail wagging; a nearby child laughing.
shots.line: And Moss? His puppy just stole his dinner.

shots.p: Moss (the main caveman: round white head, black dot eyes, messy dark hair held by a white bone hair-clip, teal striped hide tunic, tooth necklace) waving goodbye at the cave mouth at dusk, the puppy sitting at his feet with a drumstick, a warm campfire glowing behind him and the first stars coming out.
shots.line: Follow for more Stone Age Stories.
